1.name: Award-Winning AI Hologram Project
1.description: Designed the AI backend for a real-time hologram installation: camera feed → pose estimation pipeline → WebSocket projection control, all under 80ms end-to-end. Demonstrated at ITEX 2024, winning Best Booth against 200+ exhibitors.

2.name: Digital Investment Management Dashboard
2.description: Architected and coded the heavy computational logic for a data-intensive investor dashboard, providing real-time analytics and portfolio management features for Capitalino's clients.

3.name: Crypto-to-Fiat Payment Gateway
3.description: Architected and deployed a crypto-to-fiat gateway integrating blockchain transactions with fiat payment workflows. Designed secure backend services, transaction state handling, and the supporting operational infrastructure.

4.name: Financial Trading Gamification Platform
4.description: Engineered and launched a competitive gamification platform for financial trading simulations. The platform debuted at the Shiraz ITEX 2023 international exhibition to drive user engagement and demonstrate real-time data handling capabilities.

5.name: Secure Over-the-Air (OTA) Update System
5.description: Built an atomic OTA update system for 5,000+ IoT edge devices: delta compression, rollback on checksum failure, A/B partition switching. Reduced kernel boot time by 40% via PREEMPT_RT tuning and eliminating unnecessary initrd stages.

6.name: GreedyLearner: Gamified Algorithm Tutor
6.description: Developed as my Master's thesis, 'GreedyLearner' is an Android application that gamifies complex computer science algorithms to improve student motivation and learning outcomes through a guided discovery approach. The app was successfully published on app stores.

7.name: P2P Cryptocurrency Trading Platform
7.description: Architected and built a complete Peer-to-Peer cryptocurrency trading platform from the ground up. A key feature was the implementation of atomic transactions in MongoDB to guarantee financial data integrity, along with secure integration with the Ethereum blockchain via Web3.js.

8.name: Blockchain-Based Virtual Coin System
8.description: Developed a permissioned blockchain reward system on Hyperledger Sawtooth as part of the university Blockchain Committee. Users earned tokens from verified real-world actions, settled via a Node.js REST gateway with idempotency guarantees.

personal.name: Yousef Kakhki
personal.title: Bridging hardware-level efficiency with cloud-scale distributed systems
personal.description: System Architect & Technical Lead with an M.Sc. in Computer Science (System Design) from Amirkabir University of Technology (Tehran Polytechnic). Specializing in WebRTC/LiveKit live media, delayed HLS playback, high-frequency trading engines, embedded Linux, and DevOps.
personal.about:
Ten years of backend and systems work, mostly on problems where the failure modes are expensive: a deployed crypto-to-fiat gateway, a WebRTC platform serving 5,000 concurrent users with delayed HLS playback, and a Linux OTA pipeline for IoT devices.

I move between abstraction layers. One week I am tuning NATS JetStream for low-latency signaling; the next I am writing kernel patches or working through reconciliation logic with the finance team. I have led engineering teams while continuing to contribute directly to the codebase.

Currently targeting Senior Backend, Staff Engineer, or Tech Lead roles in the EU (Germany Blue Card / Netherlands HSM). M.Sc. in Computer Science (System Design) from Amirkabir University. IELTS 7.5.
